BiblicalUsage: A gift is a present, and Proverbs says a man's gift makes room for him and brings him before great men, while a gift in secret pacifies anger. Shechem offers any dowry and gift for Dinah, and the LORD gives the heave offerings to Aaron as His gift to the priests.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a gift is a test of the heart: given openly it opens doors, given in secret it can buy silence, and given to God it becomes an offering. The gift itself is neutral — the motive is what makes it holy or corrupt.
